descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT 3.9, 3.5; TFA-94514 req 7 · “record ... the model used for pre-round processing, photo capture, and Ask AI”.

Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S16 Ask on Post-Round, Hospital: 'What did the patient say?' answer time and model are logged

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 Timing and AI record (3.5, 3.9) for Post-Round Ask: each call logs the provider's own time separately from the total (aiCallLog.providerMs beside durationMs) and which model answered. … (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9; TFA-94514 item 7; TFA-92593 AC 2)
  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi … (TFA-92593 AC 2; TFA-92593 AC 3; TFA-92593 AC 6; TFA-92593 AC 9; UAT 3.4; UAT TC-17)
  • U14 AI check on scenarios, not single passes (3.2), if it applies to Post-Round Ask (Q8): the Ask set runs on at least 10 independent fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), passes at 9/10 or better, and … (UAT 3.2)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Hospital patient with a two-line bedside transcript and a generated note (own fixture for U14)

When Ask the Post-Round preset 'What did the patient say?'

Then The answer reports only what the patient said; the total time, the provider's own time and the model are recorded, and a run over 30 s is flagged for review

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): mustInclude what the patient said, mustNotInclude symptoms they did not report. Timing is a target (3.5): results.S16.ms is recorded and a run over spec.reviewOverMs (30 s) is flagged for review with Vikram (RG-FLAG), never a Fail, so there is no maxMs check. 3.9: the model comes from the runner's _meta; providerMs needs RG-DIAG. aiCheck group TC-17-ask

Where it ran: dev unit U45; test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)
